entities.name: Sammael and Hellboy crash onto subway ticket booth causing explosion
entities.description: The two battling creatures land on the ticket booth with such force that it triggers an explosion of coins, glass, and steel, damaging the structure and startling the crowd.

entities.name: Sammael strikes Hellboy sending him into turnstiles
entities.description: Sammael hits Hellboy, causing the Red Giant to land on a line of turnstiles and uproot them all during the chaotic fight on the subway platform.

entities.name: Sammael attacks with bone scythe embedding it in floor and column
entities.description: Sammael flies through the air, unfolds its bone scythe, and strikes the platform floor and a concrete column, embedding the weapon and causing structural damage.

entities.name: Sammael's struggle with bone scythe brings down part of ceiling
entities.description: As Sammael pulls its scythe free from the floor and column, the force causes a partial collapse of the ceiling, increasing the danger to those nearby.

entities.name: Mezzanine collapses onto Hellboy burying him under debris
entities.description: The mezzanine above Hellboy collapses, dropping ceiling materials, steel cables, and office furniture onto the Red Giant, temporarily burying him.

entities.name: Hellboy emerges from debris and confronts Sammael
entities.description: After being buried, Hellboy uses a desk to launch himself out of the rubble, climbs out of the crater, and taunts Sammael, re-engaging in the fight.

entities.name: Hellboy attacks Sammael with turnstile bar
entities.description: Hellboy rips off a turnstile bar and strikes Sammael repeatedly, shouting at the creature to stop hurting people, before being blocked and disarmed.

entities.name: Sammael lands hard uppercut on Hellboy launching him upward
entities.description: Sammael delivers a powerful punch to Hellboy, sending him flying into the second mezzanine, crashing through glass and sliding across the tile floor.

entities.name: Hellboy crashes through mezzanine and lands on wooden bench
entities.description: After being struck, Hellboy crashes through plate glass, slides past bystanders, collides with subway ads, and lands on a wooden bench, shattering it.

entities.name: Sammael climbs into mezzanine pursuing Hellboy
entities.description: Following the battle's momentum, Sammael advances by climbing up into the mezzanine structure above the subway platform, continuing the confrontation.

document_metadata.title: 211、INT. THE CATACOMBS - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Hellboy, devastated by Liz's death, succumbs to Grigory's pressure and begins to accept his true name, Anung-un-Rama, to open the door and save her as the eclipse nears completion.

entities.name: Hellboy awakens while chained to a massive wooden yoke
entities.description: Hellboy regains consciousness in a churchlike space, restrained by chains attached to a large wooden yoke, and begins assessing his surroundings.

entities.name: Ilsa disables explosive belt timers with a hammer
entities.description: Ilsa uses a hammer to destroy the timers on explosive belts, preventing imminent detonation.

entities.name: Myers is restrained and threatened at a blood channel
entities.description: Myers is tied to a stone pillar with a blood channel beneath his feet, leading to a large stone slab, and is kicked by Ilsa when he pleads with Hellboy.

entities.name: Grigory recites a prophetic passage facing the Abbadon mural
entities.description: Grigory, dressed in ceremonial robes and holding his leather book open, recites a passage about an angel holding the key to the bottomless pit while facing a mural of Abbadon.

entities.name: Hellboy resists the wooden yoke in growing rage
entities.description: Hellboy tenses his body in anger, causing the wooden yoke he is chained to to creak, though it remains intact.

entities.name: Grigory reveals the stone slab as a door summoned by the Ogdru Jahad
entities.description: Grigory gestures toward the stone slab brought from Lapikov, declaring it to be the door sent by the Ogdru Jahad to allow their entry into the world.

entities.name: Ilsa declares Hellboy the key to opening the stone locks
entities.description: Ilsa tells Hellboy he is the 'right hand of doom' and that the three hand imprints on the stone sculpture are meant for his arm to open the locks.

entities.name: Hellboy examines his right arm with new awareness
entities.description: Hellboy looks at his massive right arm as if seeing it for the first time, prompted by Ilsa's claim that it is the key to the stone locks.

entities.name: Ilsa kicks Myers to silence his warnings
entities.description: As Myers shouts for Hellboy not to activate the stone, Ilsa kicks him in the face to stop him from speaking.

entities.name: Lunar eclipse begins above the altar chamber
entities.description: The open dome above the altar reveals the moon, and a lunar eclipse commences, monitored by the altar's clockwork mechanism.

entities.name: Hellboy refuses to activate the stone locks
entities.description: Despite Ilsa's enticement of a promised eden, Hellboy rejects her demand and refuses to use his hand to open the locks on the stone slab.

entities.name: Ritual Summoning At The Church Altar
entities.description: A ceremonial gathering led by Grigory to open a door for the Ogdru Jahad using a stone slab, timed with a lunar eclipse and involving captives and ritual elements.
entities.summary: A ceremonial gathering led by Grigory to open a door for the Ogdru Jahad using a stone slab, timed with a lunar eclipse and involving captives and ritual elements.

entities.description: A large churchlike space with funeral niches, statues, columns, and mechanical gears, serving as the primary setting for the ritual scene.
entities.summary: A named church serves as the primary setting for key events, including a tarot reading, a confrontation between Hellboy and Kroenen, and scenes involving Hellboy and Myers, featuring a large churchlike space with funeral niches, statues, columns, and mechanical gears.

entities.name: Main nave
entities.description: The central part of the church where Myers is tied to a stone pillar near a blood channel.

entities.name: Stone pillar
entities.description: A specific structural element in the church to which Myers is restrained.

entities.name: Blood channel
entities.description: A channel beneath Myers' feet, leading to the stone slab, possibly designed to carry blood as part of the ritual.

entities.name: Altar chamber
entities.description: The specific interior space within the Church of St. Peter where the ritual summoning and confrontation are occurring.

entities.name: Dome
entities.description: The open ceiling structure above the altar chamber that reveals the sky and the lunar eclipse.

entities.name: During the eclipse
entities.description: A specific temporal window defined by the ongoing lunar eclipse, anchoring the timing of the ritual events.

entities.name: Hellboy
entities.description: A powerful supernatural being chained to a wooden yoke, central to the ritual involving the stone slab and the Ogdru Jahad.
entities.summary: A red-skinned, demon-like being with golden eyes and a tail is sighted in media and observed interacting with Broom, who calls him 'Son.' He possesses great strength, lives in isolation, desires human integration, and is part of a supernatural BPRD team, expressing surprise upon seeing Broom during an investigation.

entities.name: Ilsa
entities.description: A determined figure involved in disabling explosive belt timers and attempting to coerce Hellboy into activating the stone locks.
entities.summary: An ageless Aryan woman devoted to Grigory receives eternal life and power from him, protects him, commands Nazi scientists during a ritual, and later disappears amid a cosmic implosion, while observing the ritual's emergence from Sherpa's blood.

entities.name: Myers
entities.description: A restrained individual who warns Hellboy against activating the stone locks and is silenced by Ilsa.
entities.summary: A new FBI transfer arrives at a secure facility, undergoes screening, and is guided through a mysterious, occult-filled environment where he encounters supernatural beings like Abe Sapien and Hellboy, reacting with shock and disbelief.

entities.name: Grigory
entities.description: A robed figure reciting a prophetic passage from a leather book, claiming to have received visions from the Ogdru Jahad.
entities.summary: A mysterious figure conducts rituals to grant power and open a portal for the Gods of chaos, interacts with key allies, experiences intense physical transformation, and disintegrates during the portal's collapse, leaving no trace.

entities.name: Liz
entities.description: A character found lying at Grigory's feet, present during the ritual scene.
entities.summary: An 11-year-old girl linked to a tragic fire and a hospital patient with pyrokinetic abilities interact with Hellboy; a distressed child cries for her mother amid mysterious events involving Grigory and a larger plan.

entities.name: wooden yoke
entities.description: A massive wooden structure to which Hellboy is chained, designed to restrain his strength.

entities.name: explosive belts

entities.description: A tool used by Ilsa to destroy the timers on the explosive belts.

entities.description: A ceremonial process involving specific actions, objects, and individuals to open a portal for the Ogdru Jahad.

entities.name: Grigory offers to spare Liz in exchange for opening the door
entities.description: Grigory proposes a deal to Hellboy, offering to spare Liz's life if Hellboy agrees to open the stone door.

entities.name: Grigory extracts Liz's soul with a whispered incantation
entities.description: Grigory leans over Liz, whispers in her ear, causing her body to arch and emit a plume of energy which he inhales, leaving her lifeless.

entities.name: Hellboy breaks free from one of the wooden yoke cuffs
entities.description: Overcome with grief and rage, Hellboy struggles violently against the wooden yoke and manages to snap one of the restraining cuffs.

entities.name: Hellboy strikes Ilsa with his freed hand
entities.description: After breaking one cuff, Hellboy swats Ilsa with his free hand, causing her to stumble backward.

entities.name: Hellboy continues struggling to free his other hand
entities.description: Following the partial escape, Hellboy intensifies his efforts to break free from the remaining restraints on the wooden yoke.

entities.name: Grigory declares Liz's soul is waiting beyond the door
entities.description: Grigory informs Hellboy that Liz's soul is on the other side of the stone door and can be reclaimed if Hellboy opens it.

entities.name: Hellboy agrees to open the door for Liz's return
entities.description: After internal struggle and seeing the eclipse nearing completion, Hellboy whispers his consent to open the door, motivated by his love for Liz.

entities.name: Grigory removes Hellboy's rosary and reveals his true name
entities.description: Grigory rips the rosary from Hellboy's wrist, discards it near Myers, and commands Hellboy to speak his true name, Anung-un-Rama, to become the key.

entities.name: Hellboy speaks his true name Anung-un-Rama
entities.description: Under duress and in emotional turmoil, Hellboy closes his eyes and whispers his true name, Anung-un-Rama, initiating his transformation into the key.

entities.name: the moon is almost totally eclipsed
entities.description: A scene-relative temporal anchor indicating the near-completion of the lunar eclipse during which the ritual is taking place.

entities.name: Broom'S Rosary
entities.description: A religious artifact worn by Hellboy, symbolizing his resistance to his demonic nature; removed by Grigory to strip away his false identity.
entities.summary: Religious items symbolize identity and resistance: Broom places one on a book, Grigory removes Hellboy's to strip false identity, and Myers uses one that burns Hellboy, signifying its power and his conflicted nature.

entities.name: True Name
entities.description: A metaphysical concept representing an individual's essential nature and power; knowing and speaking one's true name is required to unlock supernatural abilities or fulfill a destiny.
entities.summary:
A mystical identifier that signifies Hellboy's authentic identity and destiny, known only to Grigory.
